title: Temporary wastewater service for new Waikapū school
summary: A committee voted 9–0 on October 19 to recommend passing Bill 116 on first reading. The bill is an agreement for temporary wastewater service to a new Central Maui school, expected to open in 2031. If the county's new wastewater plant is not running by then, the existing Wailuku-Kahului plant would take up to 14,500 gallons a day, which the director called a Plan B.
